# depends_on

Declare explicit channel dependencies for a calculation.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `section.depends_on` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Sections |
| Family | Calculation |
| Monaco kind | `section` |
| Format | `depends_on: <portal/channel>, ...` |
| Valid contexts | `channel_calculation.root` |
| Autocomplete | `depends_on: portal/channel` |

## Example
